notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game
description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Dargo, adding {R}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.
